definitions.full: H941. Buzi II. בוּזִי proper name, masculine father of Ezekiel Ezek 1:3 . בּוֺקֵר noun masculine denominative herdsman Amos 7:14 ; of Amos himself, compare בַּנֹּקְדִים אֲשֶׁרהָֿיָה 1:1 .

occurrences.englishText: Yahweh’s† “Yahweh” is God’s proper Name, sometimes rendered “LORD” (all caps) in other translations. word came to Ezekiel the priest, the son of Buzi, in the land of the Chaldeans by the river Chebar; and Yahweh’s hand was there on him.
